about.title: I work across the whole stack.
paragraphs: For the past few years I've shipped real-time dashboards, payment systems, and multi-tenant SaaS. I care about **clean architecture**, fast load times, and interfaces that explain themselves.
I work best in small teams, moving across the stack from API design to interface detail. Lately I've worked mostly in **TypeScript, Go, and edge infrastructure**.
